links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of multimodal LLMs versus board-certified oral medicine experts on same cases
links.effect: Experts outperformed both models in simple and benign cases; ChatGPT-5 gained +19/+18/+14 pp at Top-1/3/5 with images, Gemini 0/0/-2 pp.
links.quote: Human experts consistently outperformed both models in simple and benign presentations.

unlisted_practices: Quantifying the incremental diagnostic value of adding images to text (Vision-Based Diagnostic Gain) when evaluating multimodal LLMs
Stratified evaluation of LLM diagnostic accuracy by lesion type and diagnostic difficulty

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and incremental visual gain of multimodal LLMs compared to human experts on a retrospective/vignette dataset of oral lesions; it does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
